integrityPolicy: The console recomputes SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 ledger bytes and compares it with this manifest before rendering. A mismatch is shown as HASH MISMATCH. tests/test_canada_briefing_ledger.py fails if this value goes stale.

securityModel.network: same-origin ledger and manifest retrieval only
securityModel.localState: tracked actions in browser localStorage only
securityModel.claim: Open-source verification aid; no government certification or affiliation is asserted.
